scope: own reports/JPEG/commands only; residuals at recorded mean, not full PF replay

map.frame: world metres; x east, y north
map.approach_convention: boxes are grasped and placed with the robot facing east (+x)

placement.faces: interior walls: both faces; perimeter walls: inner face

landmarks.tag_frame: tag centre on the wall face; normal_xy points out of the wall into the room (the side a camera sees it from); tag x = image right seen from the front, tag y = up; size_m = outer black square

start_dock.source: authored static layout; no live robot positions or robot-to-row assignment
